summary_facts.label: Application method
summary_facts.value: In person at the responsible Japanese mission

summary_facts.label: Participation for UK nationals
summary_facts.value: Up to two one-year participations, including consecutive years

preparation_checklist.title: Read the current official guidance
preparation_checklist.description: Use the Embassy of Japan in the UK and Ministry of Foreign Affairs sources linked on this page.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm which Japanese mission has jurisdiction
preparation_checklist.description: Your place of residence determines whether you should use London or the Consulate-General in Edinburgh.

preparation_checklist.title: Check your eligibility against the current official rules
preparation_checklist.description: Confirm age, nationality/residence, passport, funds and participation-history requirements before preparing documents.

preparation_checklist.title: Prepare the documents on the current official checklist
preparation_checklist.description: Do not rely on an old saved checklist: open the current embassy instructions before applying.

preparation_checklist.title: Book the appropriate visa appointment
preparation_checklist.description: Working Holiday applications are handled in person; follow the responsible mission's current booking instructions.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final official-source check
preparation_checklist.description: Immediately before submission, compare your application pack with the latest official instructions.
